title: Elias goes into his first match (paraphrase D)
topic: A chess player named Elias plays a tournament game: a knight sacrifice, a long think by the opponent, an arbiter at the next table, the opponent resigns after forty moves
tail_E: With that victory Elias becomes the new tournament
target_note: Same target as formulations A to C: 'champion' is the natural completion of 'becomes the new tournament' after the opposing player declares his resignation and Elias steps out of the hall in triumph; the word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither do its German equivalents 'Meister' / 'Champion'. ' champion' is a single Pythia token (id 16928). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' champion') = 0.59 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ''s' 0.05); still rank 1 (p = 0.34) on the K=8 C3 rendering.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV02D, chess player Elias, paraphrase D, development family)
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV02A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Elias, wording different from A, B and C). Replacements include goes into his first match of the competition (startet in seine erste Partie des Wettbewerbs), challenger makes a pawn move after long thought (Herausforderer macht einen Bauernzug nach langer Bedenkzeit), onlookers study the game on a large monitor (Umstehende studieren die Partie auf einem großen Monitor), invests a knight in the game's middle phase (investiert einen Springer in der mittleren Partiephase - chess usage), rival broods over the board twenty minutes straight (Rivale brütet über dem Brett zwanzig Minuten am Stück), the situation grows extremely tense after the swap (die Lage wird äußerst angespannt nach dem Tausch), the umpire reviews the score sheets one table along (der Unparteiische überprüft die Notationen einen Tisch weiter), devises a brilliant move for the rook (ersinnt einen brillanten Zug für den Turm), opposing player declares his resignation forty moves in (Gegenspieler erklärt seine Aufgabe beim vierzigsten Zug), steps out of the hall in triumph (tritt aus dem Saal im Triumph - 'aus' is the preposition of 'dem Saal', not a verb particle). No separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
